title: brief-hardening one-second deadline test fails under host load
body: Outcome: test/rules/brief-hardening.test.ts 'brief CLI handles maximum-sized section lines before its one-second deadline' passes at host load 22 or measures CPU time instead of wall time (D12: no retry policy). Evidence: krn verify preflight failed on #211 at load ~22 (.krn/worktrees/memory-refs/.krn/tmp/verify-6aa145cb…/preflight.log, archived with the worktree), rerun passed.
